title: HP 12W Gulf Front Condo - Vacation Rental in High Pointe Resort,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "HP 12W Gulf Front Condo" at Highpointe Resort, located in Seacrest Beach. Wake up to endless Gulf views, unwind by the Community Pool, and grab a drink at Crabby Steve’s Beach Bar, just 1-min walk away. This 2-suite haven blends cozy vibes with modern comforts, offering a private patio for golden sunsets. Nestled perfectly between Rosemary and Alys Beach, it’s more than a stay—it’s where unforgettable memories begin. Ready to escape? Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-front patio with stunning views and sunset access – Relax and take in breathtaking ocean views as the golden sun dips below the horizon, creating unforgettable moments.Steps to Community Pool with a waterfall, kiddie pool, and hot tub – Dive into paradise with a vibrant poolside atmosphere perfect for families and relaxation seekers alike.Crabby Steve’s Beach Bar & Grill nearby – Savor the laid-back coastal vibe with delicious food and refreshing drinks just a 1-minute walk away.Private gated beach access via boardwalk – Enjoy exclusive, stress-free access to pristine sands and crystal-clear waters, just steps from your door.Exclusive High Pointe amenities, including tennis and pickleball courts – Stay active and have fun with premium sports facilities designed for both casual players and seasoned competitors.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “The unit offers an absolutely stunning view of the ocean, is steps away from the pool and beach, and the convenience of being on the ground floor made our stay even better!" – Shay⭐"30A Escapes exceeded our expectations! Outstanding service paired with breathtaking Gulf views made for a perfect getaway. We’re already counting down the days until we can return!" – Kylie⭐"We absolutely loved everything—the beautiful pool, the lively beach bar, and the seamless private beach access. The entire place was spotless and felt so warm and inviting." – Tarala*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in the spacious open-concept living area, thoughtfully designed for both comfort and breathtaking views. Step out onto the Gulf-front patio, where the beauty of the ocean meets the charm of your living space—perfect for savoring your morning coffee or enjoying sunset cocktails in style.Breathtaking Gulf views directly from the cozy living area, complete with a plush sofa and loveseat for ultimate comfortExpansive private patio featuring stylish seating for 6—ideal for unwinding with a drink or enjoying al fresco dining, plus a sun loungerOversized flatscreen TV offering endless entertainment, from movies to your favorite shows*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Prepare gourmet meals in the modern, fully equipped Chef's kitchen featuring sleek stainless steel appliances and a complete set of high-quality cookware. Savor your creations at the sophisticated dining table, perfect for memorable meals, or enjoy a casual bite at the stylish kitchen bar.Sleek stainless steel appliances: refrigerator, oven, and microwave – combining style and functionalityFully stocked kitchen with premium cookware, glassware, and utensils – everything you need to cook like a proSpacious dining table for 6, plus a cozy 3-seat breakfast bar perfect for casual meals or morning coffeeConvenient laundry area located off the kitchen for easy access*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Relax in two beautifully designed bedrooms that blend comfort with sophistication. Each space features premium bedding, ensuring restful nights after sun-filled adventures. With convenient access to modernized bathrooms, your stay is effortless and refreshing—perfect for unwinding in style.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo,*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest BeachExpansive Pool Deck Featuring a Community Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeachfront Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION ***Located in Seacrest Beach between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this condo offers prime access to 30A’s best. Walk or bike to shops, restaurants, and markets nearby.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210120
